title: Bind every required telemetry item to a test via a `// Telemetry:` header

facts.note: Required items come from acceptance decisions intersected with tracking-plan items; bindings come from `// Telemetry:` headers in any test file (no filename pattern or task reference required).
Diff-level detection of changes to acceptance telemetry requirements, tracking-plan items, or test `// Telemetry:` headers.
Set difference (required items − `// Telemetry:` header bindings across all test files) computed by the bun_telemetry_test validator.
Rule is inert until the repository adopts this rule family; adoption state must be detected.

fires: An acceptance with required telemetry lists a URN that exists in the tracking plan, and no test file anywhere carries a `// Telemetry:` header naming that URN.
An acceptance newly requires a tracking-plan URN (or the item is added to the plan) and no test binds it.
After a test is deleted or its `// Telemetry:` header removed, an adopted, still-required, resolvable item has no remaining test binding.
doesNotFire: A diagnostic log or internal span that no acceptance requires has no dedicated test.
A required URN cannot be resolved in the tracking plan (reported by the acceptance-decision rule instead).
A binding header is removed but another test file still binds the same required item.
The repository has not adopted the telemetry rule family.

given: An acceptance with required telemetry lists a concrete URN that exists in the tracking plan (a required item)
when: Required items, the tracking plan, or test files' `// Telemetry:` headers are added, changed or removed
then: Ensure at least one test file binds each required item with a `// Telemetry: <urn>` header.
prefer: Add a telemetry test whose header names the acceptance (`// Acceptance: <acc-id>`) and the item (`// Telemetry: <telemetry-urn>`), and whose body proves the item is emitted.
avoid: Leaving a required item planned and implemented but untested.
Adding a `// Telemetry:` header to a test that does not exercise the item just to close the gap.
unless: Diagnostic logs and internal spans an acceptance does not require need no dedicated test — only required items are covered by this closure.
Inert until the repository adopts this rule family.
why: Evidence leg of the traceability tripod (planned, implemented, tested): the coder rule binds the implementation, this binds the proof. A required item no test covers is a plan nobody can rely on.
evidence: For every required item (acceptance-required URN present in the tracking plan) at least one test file has a `// Telemetry:` header naming it.
The bun_telemetry_test validator reports no uncovered required items.
verifier_detail: required_item: a concrete telemetry URN listed by an acceptance whose telemetry disposition is required and that exists in the tracking plan.
Required items are collected from acceptance decisions; test bindings are collected from every `// Telemetry:` header in test files.
Report the difference (required items without a binding) at the tracking-plan item's own file.
Unresolvable required URNs belong to the acceptance-decision rule and are not double-reported here.

Fix hint from source ('Give the item its proof:'): `// tests/.../accept-response.telemetry.test.ts` / `// Acceptance: acc:commons:E001-UNIT-001` / `// Telemetry: telemetry:metric:be:commons:response-invocation-accepted:duration`.
audit: Source name: 'Every required telemetry item has a telemetry test'.

sharedNodes.text: strict: atdd-bun fails on every finding; it has no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.justification: Concrete situations following directly from the set-difference check.
